Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to correctly interpret the genealogical data presented in the search results, specifically misidentifying the maternal grandmother. In Step 6, the search results explicitly stated that "Anna of Hungary (c. 1260 - 1281) was a daughter of Stephen V of Hungary and Elizabeth the Cuman." Despite this clear evidence identifying Elizabeth the Cuman as Anna's mother (and thus Constantine's maternal grandmother), the WebSurfer (and subsequently the Planner) incorrectly concluded that Maria Laskarina was the answer. This error stems from a failure to resolve the disambiguation between two different historical figures named "Anna of Hungary" (one from the 13th century, one from the 16th century) and a failure to prioritize the specific search result that directly addressed the lineage of the relevant Anna (the wife of Andronikos II). The agent relied on a conflicting snippet regarding Maria Laskarina (who was the mother of a different Anna of Hungary, Duchess of Macs) instead of the correct lineage provided in the same search results.
